Finolex Cables net profit rises 59% in Q1FY27; accelerates fiber capex Finolex Cables posted a 59% YoY rise in Q1FY27 net profit to ₹221.28 crore, driven by strong demand in electrical and communication cables. Revenue grew 44% to ₹2,013.15 crore. The communication segment saw a surge in EBIT to ₹52.52 crore, aided by favorable inventory pricing and export growth to the US and Europe. Conversely, the copper rod plant remained shut due to LPG shortages. Management accelerated capex plans, aiming to expand fiber draw capacity to 8 million km by September 2026 to capitalize on global fiber demand
